Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC) concludes its participation in the 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026), held in Antalya, Türkiye, from 5 to 9 October. During the Congress, MBRSC announced the opening of applications for PHI-3, the third opportunity under the Payload Hosting Initiative, developed in partnership with the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA) through its ‘Access to Space for All’ initiative. The Centre also extended its cooperation with France’s space agency, CNES, in support of future missions under the Emirates Lunar Mission.

Dubai Integrated Economic Zones Authority (DIEZ) announces the doubling of the venture capital fund managed by its investment arm, Oraseya Capital, from AED500 million to AED1 billion. The expansion aims to strengthen Oraseya Capital’s capacity to support companies with global growth potential. DIEZ has also increased Oraseya Capital’s maximum investment per company from USD3 million to USD6 million, strengthening its ability to participate in larger funding rounds and support companies at more advanced stages of growth. The fund’s increased size builds on the results achieved by Oraseya Capital since its launch in November 2023. Its portfolio now comprises 66 active companies.

We have strong confidence in Dubai’s future as a global centre for capital and innovation. Our mission is to translate this confidence into investments, companies and tangible economic opportunities that support the objectives of the Dubai Economic Agenda D33, strengthen Dubai’s competitiveness, and reinforce the UAE’s position as a global hub for the new economy and investment in future sectors.
